segments.en:
Axis has entered
the Earth Sphere.

The Axis forces led by Haman Karn
have declared war on the Earth
Federation Forces and the Titans.
I am Lieutenant Quattro Bajeena.

We of the AEUG are
at odds with the Titans.

Naturally, we are also hostile to
the Redros Army, their ally.

Therefore, we would like to
propose a united front
with your forces.

Understood.
Let's fight together.

Thank you for agreeing
so readily.
Alliance formed with the AEUG.

The Argama's squad has joined
your forces.

The Titans' fleet is assembling
at the Gate of Zedan.

The operation to take the
Gate of Zedan has been launched.

rows.notes: [jp] not in glossary/UI strings; used the established Zeta Gundam English 'Gate of Zedan'. | [editorial 0] possessive as in 'the Titans' main force' elsewhere

segments.en:
Entering combat with the
Titans' main force.

The Titans' main force has
been driven off.

You can now dock at
"Gryps."

rows.notes: [jp] -> Gryps (as in 'Gryps War' elsewhere); not in glossary.

segments.en: Fleet from Axis confirmed.
Here they come!

Hey!
Hold it right there!
Whoa, what for?!

The Axis fleet is requesting
contact.

Exactly!
We talk first!

Lady Mineva, these people
wish to form an alliance
with us.
A fine attitude.

The Earth Sphere is now
in turmoil.

This pointless fighting
must be ended swiftly.

That is the very goal
our Axis strives for.

Let us fight together and
build a world of peace.
Form an alliance with Axis?

Ally
Don't ally
You heard her!

By Lady Mineva's command,
we hereby form an alliance
with your forces!

We expect great things
of you all.

Alliance formed with
the Axis forces.
You can now dock at Axis.
I see...

We gave you one last chance
to side with us...
I'm sorry...
Very well...

Then learn the power of
our Axis the hard way!!

rows.notes: Segs 8-11 (blank) read as Mineva continuing; 15 Haman; 18 narration; 20 and 23 Haman. Segs 19-23 are the refusal branch. Mineva's archaic [jp] kept as a formal register. | [editorial 17] system-message template unified

segments.en:
Now in combat with
the Axis forces.

The enemy fleet has been
driven off.
You can now dock at Axis.
Emergency transmission!

The Titans have been reorganized
under Paptimus Scirocco.

It appears the Titans have
declared war on the AEUG
all over again!

...Which means they're
our enemy, right?

And here I thought we'd
finally taken them down...

The main force of the Titans
(Scirocco) is at "Gryps."

We have a transmission from
Admiral Kowen of the
Earth Federation Forces.
From the Federation...?

I hear the Federation forces have
been stirring since Jamitov
stepped down...

They probably want to
form an alliance with us.

The Federation, allying
with us?

But hey,
isn't the Federation
basically the Titans?

...Which means we'd be
indirectly teaming up with
the Redros Army.
That's true...
Connecting now!

This is Kowen of the
Earth Federation Forces.

We are rallying the anti-Titans
factions within the
Federation forces.

We wish to form an alliance
with your forces.

To defeat the Titans under
Scirocco... and Axis
under Haman...
We need your strength!

Allying with the people of this
world is just what we want...
but...

If you are the Federation forces,
isn't the Redros Army
helping you?

We are enemies of the
Redros Army.

We can't ally with an organization
the Redros Army supports.

True... The Federation did receive
Redros Army support by way
of the Titans.

But now we reject the
Redros Army's schemes.

That's exactly why we've offered
this alliance to your forces,
not to the Redros Army.

We want to fight alongside you
for the peace and future
of the Earth Sphere!

Cooperate with the Federation's
anti-Titans faction?

Cooperate
Don't cooperate
Thank you.

Then please join up with our
elite unit right away.

The Albion's squad is resupplying
at "La Vie en Rose."
Understood.

We'll head for
"La Vie en Rose."
I see... That's a shame...

We have no intention of making
enemies of your forces.

But if you say you'll ally
with Axis, then we will
be enemies.
I see...
Then, farewell!

rows.notes: Seg 0: [jp] rendered 'Admiral Kowen' as written (glossary position says lt. general). Seg 3 (blank) read as Nelfea; seg 6 as Kanji. Segs 29-33 are the refusal branch; Kowen's line mentions an Axis alliance, kept as written.

segments.en:
Entering combat with the
Titans' main force.

The Titans' main force has
been driven off.

You can now dock at
"Gryps."

That about takes care of
the hostile forces.

Shall we head for the
next objective soon?

Yes.
Once we're ready, let's head
for the gate.

It's been a while,
Lord Redros.

The supplies I promised you
are all ready.

Please put them to good use
for the Titans.
Much obliged!

The Titans promise to maintain
their relationship with your forces
unchanged from here on.

The alliance with the Titans
has deepened.

Titans troops can now be
formed into squads.

rows.notes: Seg 1-2: header says Redros is the one delivering promised supplies to the Titans; kept that direction.

segments.en:
"Operation Apollo" has been
launched.

Take control of
Von Braun City.

rows.notes: [jp] -> Operation Apollo (Zeta Gundam); not in glossary.

segments.en:
The AEUG's main force has been
spotted near Von Braun.
The battle will now begin.

rows.notes: [editorial 1] brief template for battle-start messages (was 'Commencing battle.')

segments.en: The AEUG has been defeated.

The enemy fleet has been
driven off.
You can now dock at Axis.

Your Excellency, the enemy's
main forces have been
wiped out.

There will be no further
organized resistance.

Good. We'll pass through the gate
and head for our next objective.
